definitions.explanation: A person who walks around without clear purpose or destination. In modern Japanese, frequently used in the context of elderly people with dementia who wander away from home, a growing social concern in Japan's aging society.

examples.japanese: ⟦{深夜|しんや}→深夜：00368_shinya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{徘徊者|はいかいしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please be careful of people wandering around late at night.

examples.japanese: ⟦{認知症|にんちしょう}→認知症：04419_ninchishou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{徘徊者|はいかいしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保護|ほご}する→保護する：25374_hogosuru⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}み→取り組み：10403_torikumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっている→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: Efforts to protect dementia patients who wander are spreading.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{高齢|こうれい}→高齢：14648_kourei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{徘徊者|はいかいしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}かけたら→見かける：01644_mikakeru⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦{交番|こうばん}→交番：02879_kouban⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}する→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧よう⟦{呼|よ}びかけている→呼びかける：06480_yobikakeru⟧。
examples.english: The community is encouraging people to speak to elderly wanderers they see and contact the local police box.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{徘徊|はいかい}→徘徊：09037_haikai⟧ (wandering/roaming) and ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). In contemporary Japan, this word is strongly associated with elderly people with dementia (⟦{認知症|にんちしょう}→認知症：04419_ninchishou⟧) who leave home and cannot find their way back. This is a significant social issue in Japan's rapidly aging society, and communities have organized watch networks to help locate {徘徊者|はいかいしゃ}.

NOTE ON SENSITIVITY:
Some advocates prefer avoiding ⟦{徘徊|はいかい}→徘徊：09037_haikai⟧ when referring to people with dementia, as the word can carry negative connotations of aimless, suspicious wandering. Alternatives include ⟦{行方不明者|ゆくえふめいしゃ}→行方不明者：28538_yukuefumeisha⟧ (missing person) or simply describing the situation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {徘徊者|はいかいしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保護|ほご}する→保護する：25374_hogosuru⟧: to give protective care to a wanderer
- {徘徊者|はいかいしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}する→発見する：26929_hakkensuru⟧: to find a wandering person
- ⟦{認知症|にんちしょう}→認知症：04419_ninchishou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{徘徊者|はいかいしゃ}: a wanderer with dementia

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{徘徊|はいかい}→徘徊：09037_haikai⟧: wandering/roaming — the base verb-noun
- ⟦{不審者|ふしんしゃ}→不審者：11348_fushinsha⟧: suspicious person — a different category of concern
- ⟦{行方不明者|ゆくえふめいしゃ}→行方不明者：28538_yukuefumeisha⟧: missing person — a more neutral term
